question: Does the one frozen package-order structural candidate reproduce its local causal package set and whole-run activation, reachability, policy sensitivity, functional separation and guardrails on independent identities?
scope: This protocol independently confirms strategy-package support only. It does not calibrate or admit the seven-direction detector, optimise an RC, promote product code/content or authorise protected seeds.
method: One staged, non-adaptive held-out protocol. Stage one gives all four packages the same new 128-policy packageOrder-on none/A/B/AB target/control rectangle and gives Afterimage the complete matched null rectangle. Only a preregistered local success runs stage two, where one new 128-policy whole-run cohort compares the exact structural candidate, its exact same-content packageOrder null and live baseline on complete shared CRN rectangles.

structuralCandidate.selectionAuthority: Exactly this one candidate was frozen by discovery protocol 134d908c9db8998413e3c9858f3b9a9a09deb125ca779a23218a7a923ca549dd. No value, package, grammar or scalar cell may change.

immutableAdmittedAshPackage.use: Immutable scientific admission and independent reproduction evidence only. No historical path is reconstructed or rerun.

admissionSet.successSet: Both Dusk packages and at least one supplemental Ash package clear independent local and whole-run gates. Alongside immutable hand-size-payoff, this supplies at least two packages for each aspect before detector calibration.

contentArm.role: whole-run CRN block; candidate-minus-null isolates package order, while candidate-minus-live measures the complete frozen packet against product truth

package.blocking: Each package retains its own deck and response metric; no pooled package main effect is estimated.

localDesignMatrix.packageOrderOn: All four packages receive every arm in target and control aspects on all 128 identities.
localDesignMatrix.afterimageOrderOff: Afterimage receives every arm in target and control aspects on those same 128 identities.
localDesignMatrix.aliasStructure: On cells support each package complementarity estimand once. Only Afterimage is fully crossed with packageOrder and only it supports a held-out structural interaction. Fixed payoff, acquisition, rarity and Ward settings are not estimated.

wholeRunDesignMatrix.aliasStructure: All three arms use identical policy snapshots and simulation seeds. Candidate-minus-null identifies the structural grammar on whole-run endpoints. Candidate-minus-live measures the complete candidate packet and cannot attribute content and structure separately. Every reported endpoint has a complete matched rectangle.

cohort.commonRandomNumbers: Within every local packageOrder or arm contrast, policy root, policy index, seed, enemy, deck, content, estimator and stopping rule are identical.
cohort.independence: Root 549 and seeds 346192-346319 are disjoint from discovery root 548 and every earlier local cohort.

cohorts.commonRandomNumbers: All three content arms use the same policy identities, policy simulation seeds and RandomBuild identities on every complete grid.
cohorts.independence: Root 550, seeds 346400-346531 and canonical policy snapshots must be disjoint from the frozen root-545 and root-546 whole-run cohorts, and are numerically disjoint from discovery and local held-out identities.

estimands.localConditionalProducerEffect: Within package and aspect at packageOrder 1, consumer-card response AB minus B.
estimands.localProducerConsumerInteraction: Within package and aspect at packageOrder 1, AB minus A minus B plus none.
estimands.localTargetMinusControl: Target-aspect interaction minus matched other-aspect interaction.
estimands.heldoutAfterimageStructuralGain: PackageOrder 1 minus 0 of Afterimage target-minus-control interaction on each matched local identity.
estimands.wholeRunActivation: A policy is active only when its final deck contains both registered cards and at least one of its four simulations records registered application and consumption.
estimands.wholeRunFunctionalSeparation: Within each aspect, candidate policies active for each package and inactive for the other package.
estimands.wholeRunCandidateMinusNull: Paired structural-candidate minus same-content structural-null RandomBuild win and mean combat duration on every grid; activation-set gains and losses are descriptive mechanistic evidence.
estimands.wholeRunCandidateMinusLive: Paired structural-candidate minus live RandomBuild win and mean combat duration on every grid.

estimator.localUnit: The root-549 policy-index and seed identity.
estimator.wholeRunActivationUnit: The root-550 policy identity aggregated over the same four simulation seeds.
estimator.wholeRunSafetyUnit: RandomBuild seed or aspect-policy-seed identity, paired across all three content arms.
estimator.standardisation: Local package contrasts use the population standard deviation of all target-aspect arm responses; structural gain and duration remain raw.
estimator.bootstrap: Exactly 5000 deterministic paired bootstrap resamples with a fresh random.Random(421) stream per estimand.
estimator.multiplicity: No endpoint, package, threshold, cohort, arm, stage gate or bootstrap seed may change after the first observation.

gates.localAdmission: Both Dusk packages and at least one supplemental Ash package clear conditional, interaction, target-control, witness, fault and duration gates; Afterimage structural-gain lower bound is greater than zero.
gates.activation: Every package has at least 32 active and 32 inactive held-out policies.
gates.functionalSeparation: Within each aspect, at least eight candidate policies activate each package without activating the other.
gates.reachability: At least sixteen candidate policies acquire each final pair and record its consumer event through the reward/economy path.
gates.reliability: Zero candidate faults and zero candidate-added faults against both live and structural null on all policy and RandomBuild grids.
gates.wholeRunAdmission: Identity, activation, separation, reachability, reliability, RandomBuild, Vow-5 and duration gates pass against the complete matched live and structural-null rectangles.

decisionRules.localSuccess: Every registered local success-set gate passes. Continue exactly once to the frozen whole-run stage.
decisionRules.localFutility: A required Dusk package decisively fails, too many supplemental Ash packages decisively fail, or Afterimage structural-gain upper bound is not greater than zero. Stop at 5,120 rows, reject packageOrder and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside #421.
decisionRules.localInconclusive: Local success is not met without a registered decisive failure. Stop at 5,120 rows and record inconclusive without whole-run rows.
decisionRules.success: Local held-out passes, then all frozen whole-run identity, package and guardrail gates pass against both live and structural null. Admit the structural package set for detector construction.
decisionRules.futility: Any fixed whole-run identity, activation, separation, reachability, reliability, RandomBuild or Vow-5 gate fails, or a duration interval lies wholly above 0.25. Reject packageOrder and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside #421.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Only a duration interval is missing or straddles 0.25, or execution reaches an immutable-input, incomplete-rectangle, cache, engine, harness, row-cap or wall-cap fault. Record inconclusive at the cap and do not rerun or extend.
decisionRules.successAuthority: The independently reproduced strategy-package support set may enter preregistered seven-direction detector construction. This does not admit that detector, optimise or promote an RC, or authorise protected seeds.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close this package-order grammar and continue structurally inside issue #421 without selecting another scalar cell.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Stop at decision boundary 3. Do not add rows, alter the candidate or rerun.

stoppingRule: Run the 5,120-row local stage once. Run all 4,608 whole-run rows only after deterministic local boundary 1. Then take exactly one final decision. No optional expansion, candidate change or cohort extension exists.
deterministicOwnership: post_v38_package_order_heldout.py alone constructs every row, invokes simulation and cache, audits policy identity, fits endpoints, enforces stage and global caps and selects the decision with zero model-context tokens.

methodBoundary.adaptiveTuning: Alternative scalar cells, a second structural candidate, package-specific support, changed cohorts, new endpoints and V39-style tuning are forbidden.
